problem_statement: Alvalens/Alvalens-porto-2-nextJs is a Next.js 15 App Router developer portfolio (React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, framer-motion) with a home landing, a /projects gallery page, per-project detail pages under /projects/[slug], and an /about page. The /projects page is fronted by the 'Work radar' — the portfolio's own project browser. It is a filter strip that surfaces the site's category taxonomy (All work / Web Development / AI & ML / Other) as tabs above a live result readout ('Showing all 15 projects', or 'Showing N of 15 - <category>') and a compact preview row of matching project cards; clicking a tab re-filters the preview row, updates the readout, and drives the same active category as the full 'Other Note Worthy Projects' grid below. The same Work radar taxonomy is mirrored, in a read-only compact variant, on the /about page so the browsing model is continuous across the site. A recent change shipped the Work radar with three defects: (1) its tab and preview rows are pinned to a fixed, non-wrapping width so the whole /projects page scrolls sideways on a 390px phone; (2) it was styled with an off-brand dark palette that clashes with the light monochrome portfolio; and (3) the /about mirror was dropped, breaking the cross-page continuity. Repair the Work radar so it fits mobile with no horizontal overflow, matches the portfolio's light visual language, and appears on both /projects and /about, while keeping the tab filter fully functional (clicking a category updates the readout and preview live) and leaving all copy, routes, and surrounding content unchanged.
required_content: The Work radar renders on /projects with its category tabs (All work, Web Development, AI & ML, Other), a live result readout, and a preview row of project cards, in the portfolio's light monochrome palette.

Clicking a category tab (e.g. 'Web Development') re-filters the preview row to the matching projects and updates the readout live to 'Showing 10 of 15 - Web Development'; the count and cards are never stale.

On a 390px mobile viewport the /projects page has no horizontal overflow beyond a small tolerance: the Work radar tab row and preview row wrap/reflow to fit the screen instead of forcing the document wider than the viewport.

The Work radar taxonomy also appears on the /about page (compact variant), so the same browsing model is continuous across the site; the navbar, hero, Highlight, 'Other Note Worthy Projects' grid, project detail pages, and footer remain present and unchanged.
No new console errors or failed network requests are introduced; the portfolio continues to build and serve as a self-contained Next.js app.
design_constraints: Preserve the portfolio's design language: light grey background, near-black ink, slate accents, Poppins/Jost typography, framer-motion reveals, and the existing /projects section order (Work radar, My Projects hero, Highlight, Other Note Worthy Projects grid).
The Work radar must be legible: the active tab must have clear contrast, and preview cards must not overlap, shingle, or clip one another.
The tab filter must stay wired live — the readout label, result count, and preview cards must be derived from the current selection on every click, never snapshotted once at mount.
The repair lives in the Work radar component and its stylesheet; it must not depend on hiding overflow at the body/html/main level or clipping content off-screen to mask the layout defect.
Keep the Next.js App Router build pipeline intact — `next build` must still emit a working app served by `next start`.
state_constraints: desktop_projects captures /projects at 1440px: navbar, the Work radar (tabs + 'Showing all 15 projects' readout + wrapped preview cards) in the light palette, and the 'My Projects' hero all fit with no horizontal overflow.
mobile_projects captures the same page at 390px: with the defect the Work radar's fixed-width rows force the document wider than the viewport; the repair brings horizontal overflow within tolerance.
tablet_projects captures /projects at 834px, where the radar must fit after the repair.
desktop_projects_filter_web clicks the 'Web Development' tab and verifies the readout updates live to 'Showing 10 of 15 - Web Development' (changed from the pre-click 'Showing all 15 projects').
desktop_about and mobile_about confirm the Work radar taxonomy is mirrored on /about (cross-page continuity); desktop_project_detail confirms the per-project route is unchanged.

Source inspection confirms the Work radar layout, palette, and wiring live in app/projects/components/WorkRadar.jsx and work-radar.css, with page content and DOM held identical across solution legs except for the graded component and its cross-page presence.

change_completion: Clicking a Work radar category tab re-filters the preview row and updates the readout count live (never stale).
The Work radar renders its tabs, readout, and preview cards on /projects with the correct taxonomy.
The mobile /projects page no longer overflows horizontally: the Work radar rows reflow to fit a 390px viewport.
design_consistency: The Work radar matches the portfolio's light monochrome palette and typography, with a legible active tab and non-overlapping preview cards.
The Work radar taxonomy appears on both /projects and /about, keeping the browsing model continuous across the site.
regression: Navbar, My Projects hero, Highlight, Other Note Worthy Projects grid, project detail pages, and footer remain present and unchanged.
No new console errors or failed network requests appear on any captured state.
responsive: At 390px the Work radar tab row and preview row wrap so the document width stays within the viewport.
At 834px and 1440px the Work radar lays out cleanly with no horizontal overflow.

author_notes: Repo-grounded repair/regression_continuity/layout task on the Alvalens Next.js 15 App Router portfolio (Alvalens-porto-2-nextJs). The graded feature is the portfolio's native project browser, the 'Work radar' — the /projects category filter (All work / Web Development / AI & ML / Other) surfaced as tabs with a live result readout and a preview card row, wired to the same active category as the full project grid, and mirrored on /about. The L4 bad solution is a smart-but-wrong rebuild that overlaps and shingles the preview cards with negative margins, renders a near-white illegible active tab, keeps a fixed-width non-wrapping row that overflows 390px mobile, and freezes the readout/preview at mount so a tab click registers but the count and cards never update. The reference repair uses a wrapping fluid layout in the light palette with a live-derived readout. Four orthogonal gates discriminate: no_horizontal_overflow (tol 24), visual_regression (pixelmatch/ssim/block_fidelity on the radar), dom_assertions (cross-page radar presence on /about), and interaction_assertions (live readout after the tab click). Images under public/image/projects feed the project cards.
